name: Bahria Town Civic Centre, Phase 4
assumptions: Every block outline is a coarse trace of one off-nadir Esri satellite image, aligned to the OSM roundabout (Esri sits about 6 m east of OSM here); edges may be 5 m out.
Roofs were moved back to their bases with one lean ratio measured on a few corners, so base positions depend on the guessed block height.
Each traced block is one solid mass; real blocks are rows of separately built plazas, and small gaps between them are not modelled.
Heights of 18 to 30 m are estimates from shadow lengths and listing photos (G+3 to G+6); no surveyed height exists.
Which facade type belongs to which plaza is unknown: colours and glazing are assigned pseudo-randomly from types seen in listing photos, so no individual plaza matches its real elevation.

Which plazas stand a storey above their neighbours is chosen at random; the step itself is seen in listing photos. Window counts, 3.8 m storeys, shopfront and pale sign bands are generic; real signage, balconies, arches and pediments are omitted.
Rooftop stair and tank rooms and solar panel fields are placed generically on blocks; satellite shows such clutter but not at these exact spots.
The long pale slab on the north rim is given 6 m and no openings; its use and height are unknown.
The glazed domed block on the south-west rim is placed from satellite only; its dome is a plain white hemisphere of about 6.5 m radius.
Roundabout island is kerb and lawn only; a small object at its centre is visible in satellite but could not be identified, so it is omitted.
No site paving is modelled, so the game's own roads remain visible; Basti Food Street lies outside the site polygon and is not included.
